newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PacDun to sell A$100 mln in assets.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PacDun to sell A$100 mln in assets.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Pacific Dunlop Ltd said on Friday it planned to sell A$100 million in assets within two years.

"We have indicated that we have some non-core businesses that over the next year or two we will be divesting. In total ... they amount to about A$100 million and part of that is in the process today," Pacific Dunlop Rod Chadwick told reporters after the group's annual meeting.
PacDun has sold A$1.5 billion in assets since mid 1995 as part of the group's strategy to refocus on core businesses.
Chadwick declined on Friday to detail the A$100 million worth of assets earmarked for sale.
The group announced last month it had sold its troubled pacemaker lead manufacturer U.S.-based Telectronics, for A$170 million.
In anticipation of the sale, Pacific Dunlop provided for an abnormal loss of A$91 million from the disposal of Telectronics in its accounts for the year ended June 30, 1996.
